note: Three numbered tables are declared and cited but have no measured region: Table 0.1 on p3, Table 2.2 on p9 and Table 3.2 on p18. Their rules are drawn too faintly to clear the 25 pt minimum side, so they are left unresolved rather than given an invented bbox. Section 3.1 (the economic sensitivity analysis) is printed but never extracted as a heading, so Table 3.1 sits on the chapter path.
rules: Family follows the ink: eight figures are smoothed multi-series curves with no markers and no bars, so all eight are line [geometry.family].
Scenarios 1-4 repeat the base-case chart format exactly, so line style, legend placement and gridlines carry across Figures 3.1-3.5 rather than being re-guessed per page [geometry.legend].

Legend placement is read off the frame, not off the tick labels: 3.6 sets its keys beyond the right edge of the axes, 3.7 inside the top-right corner, 3.8 inside the top-left, and 3.1-3.5 inside the bottom-right [geometry.legend].
Table captions print above their grid and figure captions below their exhibit, so caption.position splits by family in this paper [caption.position].
Table rules: Tables 2.1 prints three-line booktabs and Table 3.1 is fully framed with a vertical rule between every column, so rule_style differs per table [table.rule_style].
No table in this paper shades alternate rows, and none of them merges cells horizontally [table.zebra].
Numbering is chapter-scoped (Table 2.1, Figure 3.6) with a period after the number and a colon after the label [caption.numbering].
Prose cites exhibits in running text, most often inside brackets, so lead_pattern is parenthetical wherever the reference sits in parentheses [mention.lead_pattern].
Section paths stop at the deepest extracted heading; the printed section 3.1 has no heading entry, so Table 3.1 carries the chapter path [place.section_path].
